phrases.phonetic_broad: kvlielitsis tsiluka

phrases.phonetic_text: v'v
phrases.phonetic_broad: vv
phrases.english_text: OK.

phrases.syllabary_text: ᎥᎬᏱ ᎨᎲ ᎬᏃᎯᏏ ᏄᏰᎸᏛ ᏥᏂᎾᏛᏁᎠ ᏣᎾᏔᏅ ᏓᎾᏕᎶᏆᏍᎬ ᏗᏂᏲᏟ ᎠᎭᎾ
phrases.phonetic_text: vkvyi kehv kvnohihsi nuyelhvtv tsininatvne'a tsanthnv tanatelhohkwahsk tiniyolhi ahana
phrases.phonetic_broad: vkvyi kev kvnoisi nuyelvtv tsininatvnea tsantnv tanatelokwask tiniyoli aana
phrases.english_text: First let me tell you the reason we are doing this. You know that kids are going to school here?

phrases.syllabary_text: ᎥᎥ
phrases.phonetic_text: v'v
phrases.phonetic_broad: vv
phrases.english_text: Yeah.

phrases.syllabary_text: ᏍᎩᏛ ᏢᏴ ᏛᎾᎴᏂ ᎠᎾᏛᏓᏍᏗᎲ Ꭿ ᏥᏂᏬᏂ ᏓᏂᏬᏂᏏ Ꮥ
phrases.phonetic_text: skitv lhvyv tvnaleni anthvtahstihv hi tsiniwoni taniwonihs te
phrases.phonetic_broad: skitv lvyv tvnaleni antvtastiv i tsiniwoni taniwonis te
phrases.english_text: One of these days they are going to start listening to us, talking how we are. Or we are going to be talking, [for them] to listen to how Cherokee is spoken. I don’t know if they are going to get that far—but the reason is for them to listen. And, also, your grandchildren or your immediate family might want to someday listen to you talking. If they come here and ask, they will let them listen to you talking, or us talking. As we begin, tell me your full name in English.

phrases.syllabary_text: ᎤᎾᏛᏓᏍᏙᏗ ᏄᏍᏛ Ꮩ ᏣᎳᎩ ᎦᏬᏂᎯᏍᏗ ᎨᎲ ᏝᏅ ᏯᏩᏅᏘ ᏍᎩ Ᏼ ᏳᏛᏅᏟᎶᏝ ᎠᏎᏅ ᎤᎾᏛᏓᏍᏙᏗ ᎤᏰᎵᏗ ᎨᏎᏍᏗ
phrases.phonetic_text: unthvtahstohti nuhstv to tsalak kawonihihst kehv tlanv yawanvhth ski yv yutvntlhilola ahsenv unthvtahstohti uyeliti kehsehsti
phrases.phonetic_broad: untvtastoti nustv to tsalak kawoniist kev tlanv yawanvt ski yv yutvntlilola asenv untvtastoti uyeliti kesesti
phrases.english_text: One of these days they are going to start listening to us, talking how we are. Or we are going to be talking, [for them] to listen to how Cherokee is spoken. I don’t know if they are going to get that far—but the reason is for them to listen. And, also, your grandchildren or your immediate family might want to someday listen to you talking. If they come here and ask, they will let them listen to you talking, or us talking. As we begin, tell me your full name in English.

phrases.syllabary_text: ᏐᎢᏂ ᎨᎲ ᏗᎨᏣᎵᏏ ᏏᏓᏁᎸ ᎢᏣᏙᏢᏒ ᏢᏴ ᏳᎾᏚᎵ ᎨᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᏅᏛᎪᏗ ᎯᏬᏂᏍᎬ
phrases.phonetic_text: so'in kehv tiketsalihs sitanelv itsatolhvhsv lhvy yunatuli kehehsti unthvkoti hiwonihskv

phrases.english_text: One of these days they are going to start listening to us, talking how we are. Or we are going to be talking, [for them] to listen to how Cherokee is spoken. I don’t know if they are going to get that far—but the reason is for them to listen. And, also, your grandchildren or your immediate family might want to someday listen to you talking. If they come here and ask, they will let them listen to you talking, or us talking. As we begin, tell me your full name in English.

phrases.syllabary_text: ᏍᎩᏅ ᏳᎾᏓᏙᎮᎵᏝ ᎨᏒ ᏴᎨᎬᎵᏍᎪᎳᏓᏏ ᎨᎮᏍᏗ ᎤᎾᏛᏓᏍᏙᏗ ᎯᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎢᏂᏬᏂᏍᎬ ᎴᏱᎩ ᎨᏒ ᎯᎢᎾᎾ ᎢᎾᎴᏂᏍᎬ ᏲᏁᎩ ᎬᏗ ᎧᎵ ᏕᏣᏙᎥ ᏍᎩᏃᎯᏏ
phrases.phonetic_text: skinv yunatatohelila kehsv yvkekvlihskolahtahs kehehsti untvtahstohti hiwonihskv iniwonihskv leyik kehs hi'inna inalenihskv yonek kvti khali tetsato'v skhinohihsi
phrases.phonetic_broad: skinv yunatatoelila kesv yvkekvliskolatas keesti untvtastoti iwoniskv iniwoniskv leyik kes iinna inaleniskv yonek kvti kali tetsatov skinoisi
phrases.english_text: One of these days they are going to start listening to us, talking how we are. Or we are going to be talking, [for them] to listen to how Cherokee is spoken. phrases.english_text: Tsisqwe Wahaya.

phrases.phonetic_text: wakhi mantan tv awatenhv
phrases.phonetic_broad: waki mantan tv awatenv

phrases.phonetic_text: unawuhs ttsenvhvwhs tsatene
phrases.phonetic_broad: unawus ttsenvvws tsatene
phrases.english_text: So, you were born just there, at your home?

phrases.syllabary_text: ᏗᏪᏅᏒᏭ
phrases.phonetic_text: tiwenvhsvwu
phrases.phonetic_broad: tiwenvsvwu
phrases.english_text: At my house.

phrases.syllabary_text: Ꮩ ᎤᏍᏕ ᎤᎾ ᏅᏱ ᎣᏓᎳ
phrases.phonetic_text: to uhste una nvyi otala
phrases.phonetic_broad: to uste una nvyi otala
phrases.english_text: What was it like there at Rocky Mountain?

phrases.syllabary_text: ᎢᎦᏛ ᎤᏛᏁᏟᏴᏒ ᎪᎯᏴ ᏥᎩ ᏞᏍᏗ ᏥᏄᏍᏛ ᏱᏄᏍᏓ ᏃᎴ

phrases.phonetic_broad: ikatv utvnetliyvs koiyv tsiki lest tsinustv yinusta nole
phrases.english_text: It has really changed nowadays. It is not like it was. Also, there are three mountains. On this side, Rocky Mountain, they call it and on this side Jackson Mountain. I grew up that way. You know where they call Mankiller Flats?

phrases.syllabary_text: ᏦᎢ ᎮᏂ ᏙᏓᎵ ᎯᎢ ᏗᏝ ᏅᏱ ᎣᏓᎳ ᏣᏃᏎᎰ ᎯᎢ ᏗᏝ Jackson Mountain ᎠᏃᏎᎰ ᎤᎾ ᎮᏂ ᏗᏝ ᎠᏩᏛᏒ ᏣᎾᏛ Ꮎ Mankiller flats ᏣᏃᏎᎰ
phrases.phonetic_text: tso'i heni totali hi'i tila nvyi otal tsanohsho hi'i tila tsakhhsan mantan anhseho un heni tila awathvhsv tsantv na mankhiwa swaths tsanhseho
phrases.phonetic_broad: tsoi eni totali ii tila nvyi otal tsanoso ii tila tsaksan mantan anseo un eni tila awatvsv tsantv na mankiwa swats tsanseo
phrases.english_text: It has really changed nowadays. It is not like it was. Also, there are three mountains. On this side, Rocky Mountain, they call it and on this side Jackson Mountain. I grew up that way. You know where they call Mankiller Flats?

phrases.syllabary_text: ᎥᎥ
phrases.phonetic_text: v'v
phrases.phonetic_broad: vv
phrases.english_text: Yes.

phrases.syllabary_text: ᎯᎤ ᏗᏝ ᎤᎦᎾᏩ ᏗᏝ

phrases.phonetic_broad: o alaki nitsie sitanelv
phrases.english_text: Oh. How many was in your family?

phrases.syllabary_text: ᎯᏍᎩᏛ ᏥᏃᏥᎥ ᎣᏥᏧᏥ ᎠᏂᎨᏳᏣᏅ ᏦᎢ

phrases.syllabary_text: ᏂᎦᏗᎨ ᏣᎳᎩ ᎢᏥᏬᏂᏍᎩ ᎨᎮ
phrases.phonetic_text: nikatikhe tsalaki itsiwonihsk kehe
phrases.phonetic_broad: nikatike tsalaki itsiwonisk kee

phrases.syllabary_text: ᏂᎦᏓᏛ ᎣᏥᏣᎳᎩ ᎬᏗ ᎣᏥᏬᏂᏍᎩ ᎨᎲ

phrases.phonetic_broad: nikatatv otsitsalki kvti otsiwonisk kev

phrases.syllabary_text: ᏙᏅ ᎤᏍᏕ ᎤᎾ ᏙᏗᏣᏛᏏᏗᏒ Ꮎ ᏛᎬᏁᏟᏙᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏥᏄᏍᏗ ᏧᏂᎾ ᎪᎯ ᏗᏂᏲᏟ ᏂᎾ Ꮩ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎢᏥᎾᎡᏭ

phrases.syllabary_text: ᏃᏭᏛ ᎣᏦᏢᏍᎬᏭ ᏦᎦᏁᎵᏙᏗ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏃᎴ ᎯᎢ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎨᏓᎵ ᏗᏝ ᎤᏪᏴ ᎤᏔᏂ

phrases.english_text: We just made things to play with. And just down the hill there was a big creek where we had a place to swim. We would clean it out.

phrases.syllabary_text: ᎣᎦᏓᏬᏍᏗ ᎣᎪᏢᏒ ᎣᎩᏅᎦᎸᎰ ᏂᎨᎲ
phrases.phonetic_text: okatawohsti okotlhsv okinvkalvho nikehv
phrases.phonetic_broad: okatawosti okotlsv okinvkalvo nikev
phrases.english_text: We just made things to play with. And just down the hill there was a big creek where we had a place to swim. We would clean it out.

phrases.phonetic_text: unawunv itsetohe
phrases.phonetic_broad: unawunv itsetoe
phrases.english_text: And you all just went there?

phrases.syllabary_text: ᎥᎥ ᎠᏎᏃ ᏂᎪᎯᎸᏲ ᎢᎾ ᏦᏣᏓᏅᏍᎬ Ꮲ ᎤᏣᏘᏂ ᏬᏤᎲ ᏃᎴ

phrases.phonetic_broad: tetskwates una

phrases.phonetic_broad: vv kesti yitakiskwti

phrases.syllabary_text: ᏝᏍ
phrases.phonetic_text: lhahs
phrases.phonetic_broad: las
phrases.english_text: No?

phrases.syllabary_text: ᎦᎵᏉᎩᏁᏭ ᏓᏥᏴᎵᏒ ᏣᎩᏑᎸᎪᏨ Ꮎ ᎡᏙᏓ ᏥᏥᏍᏕᎸᎯᏙᎲ Ꮲ ᏚᎸᏫᏍᏓᏁᎲ

phrases.phonetic_text: skin hihstelihe
phrases.phonetic_broad: skin istelie

phrases.syllabary_text: Ꭵ ᏚᏯ ᏱᎩ ᏙᏣᏕᏍᎬ ᎠᏂᎴ ᏱᎩ ᏅᏱᎴ ᏱᎩ ᏙᏍᏚᏖᏍᎪ Ꮲ ᏳᏚᎸ ᎩᎶ ᏠᎨᏏ ᎦᏅᎦᎸᏗ ᏃᎴ ᏙᏥᏏᎵᏛᏍᎬ

phrases.phonetic_broad: skoi yatantowule yik keli

phrases.phonetic_text: skohi yatantowhs
phrases.phonetic_broad: skoi yatantows
phrases.english_text: Just 10 cents?

phrases.syllabary_text: ᎥᎥ
phrases.phonetic_text: v'v
phrases.phonetic_broad: vv
phrases.english_text: Yeah.

phrases.syllabary_text: ᎠᏎᏃ ᎾᎯᏳ Ꮎ ᏥᎨᏒ ᎤᏃᏍᏗ ᎣᏍᏓ ᎢᎦ ᏲᏝ ᎨᎲ ᎠᏕᎳ ᎣᏝ

phrases.phonetic_broad: vv
phrases.english_text: Yes.

phrases.syllabary_text: ᎦᏥᎦᏙᏍᏛ Ꮎ ᏙᏳ ᏍᏊ ᏍᎦᏍᏗ ᏱᎾᏅᏛᎩ ᎢᎦᏓ ᏙᎭ
phrases.phonetic_text: ktsihkatohstv na toyu skwu skahsti yinanvtvki ikat toha
phrases.phonetic_broad: ktsikatostv na toyu skwu skasti yinanvtvki ikat toa
phrases.english_text: I was watching them. Some can really play rough, ain’t it?

phrases.syllabary_text: ‘ᏍᎦᏍᏗ ᏱᎾᎾᏛᎦ ᎮᏍᏗᎡ ᏍᎩ ᏄᏍᏛ ᏲᎨᏙᎶ ᎠᏴ
phrases.phonetic_text: skahsti yinanatvk hehsti'e ski nuhstv yoketolo ayv
phrases.phonetic_broad: skasti yinanatvk estie ski nustv yoketolo ayv
phrases.english_text: They can play rough. We don’t go to places like that.

phrases.syllabary_text: ᏝᏍᏲ
phrases.phonetic_text: lahsyo
phrases.phonetic_broad: lasyo
phrases.english_text: You don’t?

phrases.syllabary_text: ᎲᎥ ᏴᏓᎭ Ꮓ ᎠᏂᏧᏥ ᎠᎾᏖᎳᏗᏍᎪ ᎠᎭᏂ ᏳᏂᏍᏆᎸᎡᎵ Ꮎ
phrases.phonetic_text: hv'v yvtaha no anitshutsi anatheltihsko ahan yunihskwal'eli na
phrases.phonetic_broad: vv yvtaa no anitsutsi anateltisko aan yuniskwaleli na
phrases.english_text: No. Sometimes them boys join in, when they have an event here at the Cherokee Holiday. Man-to-man, I think they call it. Some of the boys join in.

phrases.syllabary_text: Cherokee holiday Ꮎ man to man ᎨᎵ ᏥᏓᏃᎮᎰ ᎢᎦᏗ ᎠᎾᏖᎳᏗᏍᎪ ᎠᏂᏧᏥ
phrases.phonetic_text: tsawakhi hawate na man tu man kel tsitanheho ikati anatheltihsko anitshutsi
phrases.phonetic_broad: tsawaki awate na man tu man kel tsitaneo ikati anateltisko anitsutsi
phrases.english_text: No. Sometimes them boys join in, when they have an event here at the Cherokee Holiday. Man-to-man, I think they call it. Some of the boys join in.

phrases.syllabary_text: Ꮎ Ꮫ Ᏺ Ꮎ Mississippi ᏂᏛᏳᏂᎶᏒ ᏍᏗᎩᏗ Ꮎ ᎤᏁᏳᏥᏗ ᏥᎨᏐ ᏳᏍᏗ ᏓᏂᏃᎮᏍᎪ
phrases.phonetic_text: na tv yo na mihsihsithi nityunilohs stikiti na uneyhutsti tsikehso yuhst taninohehsko
phrases.phonetic_broad: na tv yo na misisiti nityunilos stikiti na uneyutsti tsikeso yust taninoesko
phrases.english_text: Those that come from Mississippi, seems like—from the way they talk about them—they get mad easily.

phrases.syllabary_text: ᎩᎳᏫᏴ ᏍᏓᏯ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏳᎾᏓᏛᏗ ᎠᎾᏗᎰ ᏝᏅ ᏯᏩᏅᏘ Ꮩ ᏱᎩ
phrases.phonetic_text: khilawihyhv stay kohuhsti yhunatatvti a'ntiho tlanhv yawanvthi to yiki
phrases.phonetic_broad: kilawiyv stay kousti yunatatvti antio tlanv yawanvti to yiki
phrases.english_text: Quickly, they will do something hard to you, they say. I don’t know if it's true.

phrases.syllabary_text: ᏳᎾᏓᏛᏂᏍᏙᏓ ᎾᎯᏳ ᏳᎾᏓᏍᏆᎸᏂᎳᎴ ᏱᎩ ‘Ᏺ
phrases.phonetic_text: yunatatvnhstohtha nahihyu yuntahskwalvnille yiki yo
phrases.phonetic_broad: yunatatvnstota naiyu yuntaskwalvnille yiki yo
phrases.english_text: If they run into you, or hit you in the head, they would get mad real quick.

phrases.syllabary_text: ᏳᏂᎿᎸᎪ ᎩᎳᏭ ᏱᎪᎯᏓ
phrases.phonetic_text: yuninhalko kilawu yikohita
phrases.phonetic_broad: yuninalko kilawu yikoita
phrases.english_text: If they run into you, or hit you in the head, they would get mad real quick.

phrases.syllabary_text: ᏂᎯ ᏍᏊ ᏣᏁᏦᏁ ᎯᏫᎾ ᏥᎨᎲ
phrases.phonetic_text: nihi skwu tsanetsone hiwina tsikehv
phrases.phonetic_broad: nii skwu tsanetsone iwina tsikev
phrases.english_text: Did you play when you were a young man?

phrases.syllabary_text: ᎥᎥ Ꮎ ᏦᎪᏢ ᏄᏍᏛ ᎬᏪᏙᎸ ᏗᏪᏙᎸ
phrases.phonetic_text: v'v na tsokolhv nuhstv kvwetol twetolv
phrases.phonetic_broad: vv na tsokolv nustv kvwetol twetolv
phrases.english_text: Yeah. Just where we have it, I’ve just been there.

phrases.syllabary_text: ᎤᏔᎾ Ꮫ ᏕᏣᎵᏍᏓᏴᎲᏍᎪ
phrases.phonetic_text: uthan t tetsalhstayhvhsko
phrases.phonetic_broad: utan t tetsalstayvsko
phrases.english_text: Do you all have a big feast, when y'all meet?

phrases.syllabary_text: ᎥᎥ
phrases.phonetic_text: v'v
phrases.phonetic_broad: vv
phrases.english_text: Yeah.

phrases.syllabary_text: ᏱᏗᏣᏠᏏ
phrases.phonetic_text: yittsalhohsi
phrases.phonetic_broad: yittsalosi
phrases.english_text: When you all meet?

phrases.syllabary_text: ᎥᎥ
phrases.phonetic_text: v'v
phrases.phonetic_broad: vv
phrases.english_text: Yes, and also ball sticks they call them. Dilasgvtlvdodi, that’s what they call them, we make them ourselves.

phrases.syllabary_text: ᏃᎴ Ꮎ ᏗᎳᏍᎦᎵᏗ ᏓᏃᏎᎰ Ꮎ ball sticks ᏗᎳᏍᎦᎵᏗ ᎮᏂ ᏓᏃᏎᎰ
phrases.phonetic_text: nole na tilahskalhit tanohseho na taw hstikhhs tilahskalti heni tanhohsho
phrases.phonetic_broad: nole na tilaskalit tanoseo na taw stiks tilaskalti eni tanoso
phrases.english_text: Yes, and also ball sticks they call them. Dilasgvtlvdodi, that’s what they call them, we make them ourselves.

phrases.syllabary_text: ᏍᎩᏏ ᏓᏃᏎᎰ
phrases.phonetic_text: skhihs tan'ohseho
phrases.phonetic_broad: skis tanoseo
phrases.english_text: Is that what they call them?

phrases.syllabary_text: ᎣᎬᏏ ᏙᏦᏢᏍᎪ
phrases.phonetic_text: okvhsi totsolhvhsko
phrases.phonetic_broad: okvsi totsolvsko
phrases.english_text: We make our own.

phrases.syllabary_text: Ꭳ ᏝᎲ ᏗᏩᏒ ᏱᏗᏣᏗᏍᎪ
phrases.phonetic_text: o tlhahv thiwhahsv yittstihsko
phrases.phonetic_broad: o tlav tiwasv yittstisko
phrases.english_text: So y’all don’t buy the ones you use?

phrases.syllabary_text: ᎲᎥ
phrases.phonetic_text: hv'v
phrases.phonetic_broad: vv
phrases.english_text: No.

phrases.syllabary_text: ᎢᎦ ᎾᎮ ᏍᏊ ᎦᎸᎳᏗ ᏚᏂᎦᏩᏟᏗ ᏙᎭ
phrases.phonetic_text: ik nahe skwu kalvlat tunikawaliti toha
phrases.phonetic_broad: ik nae skwu kalvlat tunikawaliti toa
phrases.english_text: I bet they cost a lot.

phrases.syllabary_text: ᎡᎵ ᏛᎮ
phrases.phonetic_text: eli tvhe
phrases.phonetic_broad: eli tve
phrases.english_text: They do.

phrases.syllabary_text: ᏌᏊ ᎮᏂ Ꮎ ᎠᏧᏥ ᎤᎾ ᏧᏲᎱᏒ ᏍᎪᎯᏍᏈ ᏕᎦᏈ ᏣᏗᎲ ᏥᏕᎦᏂᏙᎲ
phrases.phonetic_text: sakwu hen na atshutsi una tsuyohuhs skohihskwi tekkwi tsa'thv tsitekanithv
phrases.phonetic_broad: sakwu en na atsutsi una tsuyous skoiskwi tekkwi tsatv tsitekanitv
phrases.english_text: One boy, at Belfonte, said he paid $100 for the ones he had.

phrases.syllabary_text: boy Ꮎ ᎪᎯ ᏥᏂᏃᎮᏍᎬ Ꮎ sale ᏥᏄᏅᏃ ᏥᏓᏢ ᏔᎵ ᏥᏓᎩᏩᏒ ᏑᏓᎵᏍᎪ ᎢᏅ ᏥᏓᏩᏈᏴᎲ ᏌᏭᎭ
phrases.phonetic_text: to na kohi tsininhehskv na hsew tsinunvno tsitatlhv tha'l tsitakhiwhsv sutalhsko inv tstawkwiyvhv sawuha
phrases.phonetic_broad: to na koi tsinineskv na sew tsinunvno tsitatlv tal tsitakiwsv sutalsko inv tstawkwiyvv sawua
phrases.english_text: Boy… What we were talking about a while ago—where they have that sale, there were two on there. I bought them. I paid $60 a piece for them. They are good. I wonder who made them.

phrases.syllabary_text: Ꭳ
phrases.phonetic_text: o
phrases.phonetic_broad: o
phrases.english_text: Oh.

phrases.syllabary_text: ᎢᎦᏅ ᏍᏊ ᏧᏖᏗ ᎦᎪ ᏧᏬᏢᏅ ᎨᎮ
phrases.phonetic_text: ikanv skwu tsutheti kako tsuwolhvnv khe
phrases.phonetic_broad: ikanv skwu tsuteti kako tsuwolvnv ke
phrases.english_text: They were really good. I wonder who made them?

phrases.syllabary_text: ᏗᎦᏅᎯᏗᏍ
phrases.phonetic_text: tikanvhiths
phrases.phonetic_broad: tikanvits
phrases.english_text: Are they long?

phrases.syllabary_text: yeah ᏗᎦᏅᎯᏛ
phrases.phonetic_text: ya tikanvhitv
phrases.phonetic_broad: ya tikanvitv
phrases.english_text: Yeah, they are long.

phrases.syllabary_text: ᎠᏯ ᎮᏂ ᏗᏍᏆᎳ ᏓᏮᏯ Ꮭ ᏯᏩᏅᏘ ᏗᏂᏲᏟ ᏧᏅᏙᏗ ᎤᏂᏰᎸ ᏱᎩ Ꭿ Ꮲ ᏗᎬᏅᎯᏓ
phrases.phonetic_text: ay heni tihskwala tawvya la yawanthi tiniyolhi tsuntoti uniyelv yiki hi tlv tkvnhita
phrases.phonetic_broad: ay eni tiskwala tawvya la yawanti tiniyoli tsuntoti uniyelv yiki i tlv tkvnita
phrases.english_text: I have short ones. I don’t know, for the kids to use if they feel like it. They are this long [gestures].

phrases.syllabary_text: ᎢᎦᏛ ᏗᏍᏆᎳ ᏓᏅᏗᎰ
phrases.phonetic_text: ikat tihskwal tanvtho
phrases.phonetic_broad: ikat tiskwal tanvto
phrases.english_text: Some use short ones.

phrases.syllabary_text: ᏍᎩᏍ
phrases.phonetic_text: skihs
phrases.phonetic_broad: skis
phrases.english_text: Is that right?

phrases.syllabary_text: ᎢᎦᏗᏅ ᏗᎦᏅᎯᏓ Ꮎ ᎮᏂ ᎠᏂᏧᏣ ᏕᎦᏥᏕᎸ
phrases.phonetic_text: ikatinv tikanvhita n heni anitshuhths tekatsitelv
phrases.phonetic_broad: ikatinv tikanvita n eni anitsuts tekatsitelv
phrases.english_text: And some use long ones. I gave them boys some when they wanted some, to play with them, for free. There’s no reason to sell them—God has provided.

phrases.syllabary_text: ᏥᏚᎾᏚᎸ ᏧᎾᏁᏟᏗ ᏫᏓᏂᏁᎲᎾ ᏱᎩ ᎠᏎᏭ ᏕᎦᏥᏕᎰ ᏝᏂ ᎪᎱᏍᏗ ᏳᏰᏟᏗ ᏱᏛᎬᏂᏕᎩ ᎤᏁᏝᏅ Ꮎ ᎤᏓᏁᎸ
phrases.phonetic_text: tsitunatulv tsunanelthi witaninehvn yiki ahsewu tkatsiteho tlani khuhsti yyeliti yitvkvniteki unelhanv nha utanelv
phrases.phonetic_broad: tsitunatulv tsunanelti witaninevn yiki asewu tkatsiteo tlani kusti yyeliti yitvkvniteki unelanv na utanelv
phrases.english_text: And some use long ones. I gave them boys some when they wanted some, to play with them, for free. There’s no reason to sell them—God has provided.

phrases.syllabary_text: Ꮭ Ꮫ ᏍᏊ Ꮎ handmade ᏥᏓᏃᎮ ᏱᎨᎮ Ꮎ ᏚᏩᏍᎬ Ꮎ ᎠᏕᎳᎰᎯᏍᏗ ᎮᏅ Ꮎ machine ᎬᏔᏅ ᎨᎲ
phrases.phonetic_text: tla tv skwu na hantmet tsitanohe yikhe nha tuwhahskv na atelhohihsti henv na mahsin kvthan kehv
phrases.phonetic_broad: tla tv skwu na antmet tsitanoe yike na tuwaskv na ateloisti env na masin kvtan kev
phrases.english_text: Those he bought were not what they call handmade. You could tell a machine was used.

phrases.syllabary_text: ᎠᏕᎳᎰᎯᏍᏗᏛ
phrases.phonetic_text: atelhohihstitv
phrases.phonetic_broad: ateloistitv
phrases.english_text: You can tell.

phrases.syllabary_text: Ꮎ Ꭱ ᏌᏊ ᎦᎷᎪ Ꭱ Rocky Ford ᎨᎵ ᏓᏳᏂᎩᏗ ᎤᏛᏒ
phrases.phonetic_text: na e sakwu kaluhko e wakhi sawt keli tayunikiti uthvhsv
phrases.phonetic_broad: na e sakwu kaluko e waki sawt keli tayunikiti utvsv
phrases.english_text: You can tell. There is one that comes, I think he is from Rocky Ford, or grew up there. He is married to that Mankiller-girl, or is it married to that Bearpaw-girl? We taught him to make them. He is doing really good at making them.

phrases.syllabary_text: Ꮎ Mankiller ᎠᎨᏳᏥ ᎠᏂᏁᎵ ᎾᎴ ᏱᎩ Ꮎ Bearpaw ᎠᎨᏳᏥ ᎠᏂᏁᎵ ᏍᎩᏂ
phrases.phonetic_text: na mankhiwa akeyutsi anineli nale yiki na tatha akeyutsi aninel'i skini
phrases.phonetic_broad: na mankiwa akeyutsi anineli nale yiki na tata akeyutsi anineli skini
phrases.english_text: You can tell. There is one that comes, I think he is from Rocky Ford, or grew up there. He is married to that Mankiller-girl, or is it married to that Bearpaw-girl? We taught him to make them. He is doing really good at making them.

phrases.syllabary_text: ᎣᏤᏲᏅ ᏧᏬᏢᏗ ᏙᏳ ᎡᎵ ᎣᏏ ᎾᏛᏁ ᏕᎪᏢᏍᎬ
phrases.phonetic_text: otseyhonv tsuwolhvt toyu eli ohsi natvne tkotlhskv
phrases.phonetic_broad: otseyonv tsuwolvt toyu eli osi natvne tkotlskv
phrases.english_text: You can tell. There is one that comes, I think he is from Rocky Ford, or grew up there. He is married to that Mankiller-girl, or is it married to that Bearpaw-girl? We taught him to make them. He is doing really good at making them.

phrases.syllabary_text: ᏕᎪᏢᏍᎬ
phrases.phonetic_text: tekolhvhskv
phrases.phonetic_broad: tekolvskv
phrases.english_text: Making them.

phrases.syllabary_text: ᏃᎴ ᏍᏆᏞᏍᏗ ᏱᏙᎪᏢᏂ ᏍᏊ ᎣᏍᏗᏅ ᏕᎦᏰᏫᏍᎪ
phrases.phonetic_text: nole skwalhehst yitokolhvni skwu ohstinhv tekayewihsko
phrases.phonetic_broad: nole skwalest yitokolvni skwu ostinv tekayewisko
phrases.english_text: And also, he makes [stickball] balls. He sews them well.

phrases.syllabary_text: Ꮩ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎠᏂᏢᏍᎪ Ꮎ ᏍᏆᏞᏍᏗ

phrases.phonetic_broad: to usti anilvsko na skwalesti

phrases.phonetic_text: e set t tekotlhvhsko hiyhv
phrases.phonetic_broad: e set t tekotlvsko iyv

phrases.syllabary_text: ᏎᎷ Ꭹ
phrases.phonetic_text: selu ki
phrases.phonetic_broad: selu ki
phrases.english_text: Corn?

phrases.syllabary_text: ᏎᏗ
phrases.phonetic_text: seti
phrases.phonetic_broad: seti
phrases.english_text: Walnuts.

phrases.syllabary_text: ᏎᏗ Ꭳ
phrases.phonetic_text: seti o
phrases.phonetic_broad: seti o
phrases.english_text: Walnuts, oh.

phrases.syllabary_text: ᏐᎯ ᎴᏱ ᏙᎪᏢᏂ ᎤᎾ Ꮓ ᏱᎪᏢᏂ
phrases.phonetic_text: sohi leyi tokolhvni un no yikolhvni
phrases.phonetic_broad: soi leyi tokolvni un no yikolvni
phrases.english_text: Or, he makes them with hickory nuts, when he makes them. He makes them beautiful. He makes good ball sticks too. He is learning.

phrases.syllabary_text: ᏧᏬᏚᏧ ᏂᏕᎬᏁᎰ ᏗᎳᏍᎦᎵᏗ ᏍᏊ Ꮩ ᎣᏍᏗ ᏕᎪᏢᏍᎪ ᎠᏕᎶᏆ
phrases.phonetic_text: tsuwotutsu nitekvneho tilahskalhiht skwu to ohst tekolhvhsko atelhohkwa
phrases.phonetic_broad: tsuwotutsu nitekvneo tilaskalit skwu to ost tekolvsko atelokwa
phrases.english_text: Or, he makes them with hickory nuts, when he makes them. He makes them beautiful. He makes good ball sticks too. He is learning.

phrases.phonetic_text: nhihnhv skwu hikhath titsolhvti
phrases.phonetic_broad: ninv skwu ikat titsolvti

phrases.syllabary_text: ᏥᏕᎪᏢᏂ Ꮫ ᏥᎨᎲ ᎯᎢᏃ ᎠᎩᏄᎸᏅ ᏓᏩᎵᏇᏅᎾᏁᎲ ᏗᏬᏰᏂ Ꮎ drawknife ᏱᎬᏗ
phrases.phonetic_text: tsitekolhvni t tsikehv hi'ino akinulvnv tawlhihkwnvnanehv tiwo'yen na twakhnis yikvti
phrases.phonetic_broad: tsitekolvni t tsikev iino akinulvnv tawlikwnvnanev tiwoyen na twaknis yikvti
phrases.english_text: I could make them too. But now I can’t, because my hands will start cramping if I use a drawknife [woodwork hand tool].

phrases.syllabary_text: ᏙᏅ ᎤᏍᏗ ᎠᏓ ᎲᏗᎰ ᏍᎩᎾ ᏗᎳᏍᎦᎵᏙᏗ ᏗᎪᏢᏗ
phrases.phonetic_text: tonv uhsti at hvtiho skina tilahskaltti tikolhvti
phrases.phonetic_broad: tonv usti at vtio skina tilaskaltti tikolvti
phrases.english_text: What kind of wood do you used to make ball sticks?

phrases.phonetic_text: wane'i
phrases.phonetic_broad: wanei
phrases.english_text: Hickory.

phrases.syllabary_text: ᏩᏁᎢ
phrases.phonetic_text: wane'i
phrases.phonetic_broad: wanei
phrases.english_text: Hickory.

phrases.syllabary_text: ᏂᎦᎵᏍᏗᏭ Ꮫ ᏴᎬᏗ ᏲᏚᎵ ᏍᏊ ᏂᎦ
phrases.phonetic_text: nikalhstiwu t yvkt yotuli skwu nika
phrases.phonetic_broad: nikalstiwu t yvkt yotuli skwu nika
phrases.english_text: You could use any kind you want. If you wanted to. As long as --

phrases.syllabary_text: ᎠᎼᏍ ᏕᎯᎳᏗᏍᎪ
phrases.phonetic_text: amohs thehiltihsko

phrases.english_text: They pay them more than they do the other workers. I was the leader of 12 when I retired. We were out there in the field with the bosses. They were asking me, "These 12 that you are in charge of, we are going to move them over 'here.'" Then he asks, "What is the reason you are doing that?" I said to him. “Some different people are going to come. I think 30 of them. Some kind of people,” he said. “You are going to be teaching them,” he told me. “You are going to teach them to stand those up good, like you are doing.” he told me. As for me “I don’t think so,” I told him. “I can retire today,” I told him. “I have worked here long enough,” I told him. I didn’t come the next day. I quit. I told them I was going to retire. And the others, that I was leading, worked two weeks, and some a week. And [then] they quit. They didn’t want that Mexican boss that they had to work [for], over there. And my brother, the one they call Jimmy Dean—he was the boss there too.

phrases.english_text: One time at Rocky Mountain, to the south, my grandfather lived on a hill. Me and the boys were walking in the field. And they said “There is a big hole over there in the ground.” We went there, and there was a locust [tree] this big [gestures]. It was long and sticking in there—it was just smooth. I don’t know if it was coons or something was crawling around on there, it was clean. It was just smooth. “Y’all get away,,” the boy said. “Let’s leave!”, he said. phrases.english_text: My son they got sent to Texas. He used to fight fires—he was a Fire Dancer. He was in that group. When that space shuttle fell, they had to find the remaining parts. They got hired in Texas. He was saying they were seeing snakes, “One right after another we were killing them.” He said “Someone found out we were killing them. Someone came and said ‘The next time I find out one of you all killed a snake, you are going home’.” He said “Sometimes we would be walking over the sage, or something was this tall [gestures]. Sometimes their heads would be above that, doing this [gestures]. They warned us not to kill them.” he said.
